QuestInfo.name: Hunting Lessons 3
QuestInfo.0: Your second hunt went fine, but this doesn't look any more edible. Is there anything around here to eat besides bugs? Talk to Moonbeam.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam is laying into you for not eating your bugs. She says that's why you'll never have nice ears or a tail. That's just mean.\r\n\r\nShe wants you to get some #t4009221#s, which actually doesn't sound too terrible.
QuestInfo.2: At last, you have something you can eat. #t4009221#s aren't exactly your favorite, but they're a step up from bugs. Some fruits from the nearby tree would be nice, too. Grab some when Moonbeam's not looking.

0.0: Y'know, you look kind of dumb but your hunting skills are still better than Lumps! #o2400201# is much, much tastier than #o2400200#, but it always gets stuck in my teeth. Here, have some.
0.1: Are you for real? You're so picky! THAT'S why you don't have ears or a tail. You gotta try new things! How about some #t4009221#s? Can you eat those?

yes.0: The thing is, they're hard to get. Momma #o2400202# is really protective because we took so many. Now she carries them on her head! Crazy, right? I think #r20 #t4009221#s#k will be enough for you.

no.0: You're impossible to please, you know that? If you're not gonna eat bugs, you have to eat SOMETHING!

1.0: How goes the hunt? I hope you didn't come back empty-handed!

default.0: You can't call yourself a Pointy-Ear Fox if you can't even hunt stupid caterpillars!
